The one sign-in form. Its body morphs in place through the sign-in methods, the browser hand-off, the license choice and Done, inline, in a sheet or in the browser. No sheet or dialog stacks on it; `presentation` and `replace` take the same values in every kit. Every step carries the product header (icon or monogram, then the name). A person who declines the sign-in in the browser sees "Sign-in declined" (`sign-in-denied`), and any other end that is not a success sees "Sign-in failed" (`sign-in-failed`): the first is the person's answer, the second is an error with Try again.

## In each kit

<Tabs syncKey="ui-kit">
  <TabItem label="Terminal (Python)">
    <KitStatus kit="terminal-python" />

    **Drop-in.** `login` / `sign-in`: the browser presentation only (SIGN-IN.md §4.15): it opens the browser and waits; Enter opens it again, `c` uses a code, Esc cancels; `--json` prints `pending` then the result.

    **Styled part.** `screens.sign_in(kit, view)` in `polaris_key.ui.terminal`, drawn with a `Kit`; restyle through
    `Theme(colors=…, symbols=…, preset="native")`.

    **Headless.** `SignInModel` over `identity.sign_in.start()` and its session's `wait()` in `polaris_key.ui.core.models`.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Terminal (Node)">
    <KitStatus kit="terminal-node" />

    **Drop-in.** `login` (`loginFlow`) is the terminal's sign-in: it hands off to the browser
    ([SignInHandoff](/docs/build/ui/components/sign-in-handoff/)) and ends on the signed-in line
    (`done`), or says the product has no accounts when Identity is off (`error`). A terminal shows
    no sign-in form and no license rows: the license is chosen in the browser. A key goes through
    `activate`.

    **Styled part.** `productHeader`, `stepRow` and `endRow`.

    **Headless.** None of its own: `login --json` streams the states, and `handoffView` covers the
    hand-off.

    [Terminal (Node)](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/terminal-node/) has the adapter's options, the
    `--json` contract and the fallbacks.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="SwiftUI">
    <KitStatus kit="swiftui" />

    **Drop-in.** The one sign-in form inside `.polarisKeyGate` (inline, the default) or `.polarisKeySignIn(isPresented:model:)` (`presentation: "sheet"`): its body morphs in place with `.push(from: .trailing)`, an instant swap under Reduce Motion.

    **Styled part.** `SignInView(model:providers:)`, with the steps `SignInMethodsView`, `SignInHandoffView`, `LicenseChoiceView` and `ReplaceDeviceView`; `.signInStyle(_:)`.

    **Headless.** `KitStates.signIn(_:)`; `PolarisKeyGateModel.beginSignIn()`, `reopenBrowser()`, `useCode()` (the same request's code) and `cancelSignIn()`. Until the SDK's grant API lands, a sign-in ends on Done or the toast; the in-app choice renders when the inputs carry it.

    **On a Mac.** The form is one 440 pt sheet, or an `NSHostingController` window you present with `beginSheet` ([Hosting in AppKit](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/swiftui/#hosting-in-appkit)).

    [SwiftUI](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/swiftui/) has the theme, the restyle hooks and the sample.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Electron">
    <KitStatus kit="electron" />

    **Drop-in.** Drawn by `<PolarisKeyGate>` when the license state calls for it, in the chrome of the OS.

    **Styled part.** The React kit's `<SignIn />`, drawn in the macOS, Windows or GNOME chrome with `theme.platform: "auto"`; restyle through `data-part` and the `--pk-*` hooks.

    **Headless.** `viewOf("SignIn", input)`.

    [Electron](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/electron/) has the bridge, the menu and the sample.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Compose">
    <KitStatus kit="compose" />

    **Drop-in.** `PolarisKeyGate(client, signIn = true) { }` runs the device-code sign-in inside the gate.

    **Styled part.** `PolarisSignInScreen(ui)` over `PolarisSignInState(client.signInActions(), scope)`, or `KitSignIn(inputs, presentation)` for the form ([Sign-in on its own](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/compose/#sign-in-on-its-own)).

    **Headless.** `PolarisSignInState` in `polaris-key-ui-core`.

    ```kotlin android
    import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
    import androidx.compose.runtime.LaunchedEffect
    import androidx.compose.runtime.collectAsState
    import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
    import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
    import androidx.compose.runtime.rememberCoroutineScope
    import im.plrs.key.sdk.PolarisKeyClient
    import im.plrs.key.ui.PolarisSignInScreen
    import im.plrs.key.ui.PolarisSignInState
    import im.plrs.key.ui.signInActions

    @Composable
    fun MySignIn(client: PolarisKeyClient, onCancel: () -> Unit) {
        val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
        val state = remember(client) { PolarisSignInState(client.signInActions(), scope) }
        val ui by state.ui.collectAsState()
    LaunchedEffect(state) { state.start() }
    PolarisSignInScreen(ui, onCancel = onCancel, onRestart = state::restart)
    }
    ```

    [Compose](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/compose/) has the one-liner, the sample and the routes; Compose Desktop opens the same screens in OS windows.
